title: Contact (offline demonstration)
description: A demonstration contact form. Your message reaches this website own server, is checked once against the site configuration and is then discarded. No email is sent and nothing is stored.

sections.heading: What this page demonstrates
sections.body:
This page shows how a Foundation website can host a contact form that is authored as page content and configured per website. The form below is deliberately **offline**: it exercises the complete submission path - browser, server, verified site identity, the site own form record and the Connect demonstration transport - without contacting any mail provider.

Please use fictional details. Nothing you type is delivered, stored or forwarded.
